fact: Axione Gabon states the ACE submarine cable system links Gabon to the international network and carried a significant share of national traffic, with full service restored on 4 June 2026 after a fault on its terrestrial section on 27-28 May 2026 (a repaired outage, so the route is in service).
TM Africa states Gabon already lands four subsea cable systems (2Africa, ACE, Maroc Telecom's West Africa cable and SAT-3/WASC); landing stations are not named for them.
system: 2Africa; ACE; Maroc Telecom West Africa cable; SAT-3/WASC

fact: SPIN's ACE Gabon page states ACE is the second submarine cable operated in Gabon, an alternative to SAT-3 operated by Gabon Telecom; ACE Gabon holds and operates the Libreville landing station (page date 2019-01-24, no event date given).

SPIN (the Gabonese state infrastructure holder) states that on 10 November 2025 the Gabonese national backbone (BNG) and the Equatorial Guinean national fibre network were inaugurated as physically and logically interconnected at Meyo-Kyé/Ebebeyin, with traffic tested between Bitam and Ebebeyin and between Libreville and Bata, ensuring continuity of international traffic.
Minister Doumba told WTDC-25 that Gabon has four international submarine cables providing its digital opening to the world; landing stations are not named.
